ocean.definition: The one great body of salt water that covers most of the Earth.
ocean.example: The ocean is one big connected sea, not many small ones.

tax_residency.definition: The status that decides which country has a claim to tax your income, usually based on where you spend most of your time.
tax_residency.example: Tax residency is the part nobody checks before they book the flight.

vegetable.definition: A plant we eat for the part that is not the seed, like a carrot or a cabbage.
vegetable.example: Broccoli and carrot are both vegetables.
